explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, checking only ordinary `#text` tokens via `get_token_type()` and `get_modifiable_text()`. Matching text nodes are wrapped by emitting `<mark>` around `serialize_token()`, which preserves normalized HTML serialization for all other tokens, including omitted tags and canonical quoting/encoding.
